name: record_id
description: Unique record identifier composed of dataset code, year, and sequence number

name: year
description: Observation year ranging from 2018 to 2035

name: country
description: Country where the organization is domiciled (52 countries across all income groups)

name: country_income_group
description: World Bank income classification of the country

name: region
description: World Bank geographic region of the country

name: industry
description: Industry sector of the organization (16 sectors)

name: occupation
description: Job title / occupational category of the workforce cohort observed (108 occupations)

name: company_size
description: Categorical company size: Small (10–200 employees), Medium (200–1,000), Large (1,000–10,000), Enterprise (10,000+)

name: annual_revenue_usd
description: Annual company revenue in US dollars, adjusted for company size bracket

name: employee_count
description: Total number of employees in the organization at time of observation

name: digital_maturity_score
description: Composite index (0–1) measuring the organization's digital infrastructure, culture, and capability; derived from country and industry digital readiness

name: ai_adoption_rate
description: Share of business processes and workflows incorporating AI tools or automation (0–1)

name: generative_ai_adoption
description: Proportion of workers actively using generative AI tools (e.g., LLMs, image generators); near-zero before 2022, growing post-2023

name: automation_level
description: Proportion of tasks within the occupational cohort that have been automated using AI or robotics

name: ai_investment_usd
description: Annual organizational expenditure on AI technologies, platforms, and services in USD

name: employee_ai_training_hours
description: Average annual hours of AI-related training per employee within the organization

name: jobs_before_ai
description: Number of jobs in the observed occupational cohort before the current AI adoption cycle

name: jobs_after_ai
description: Number of jobs in the occupational cohort after AI adoption effects are applied

name: jobs_created
description: New jobs created due to AI adoption (new roles, augmented positions, AI-support functions)

name: jobs_displaced
description: Jobs eliminated or substantially redefined due to automation in the period

name: job_transformation_rate
description: Ratio of total job churn (displaced + created) to baseline jobs; measures pace of occupational transformation

name: reskilling_rate
description: Proportion of displaced workers who successfully transition to new roles through reskilling or upskilling programs

name: average_salary_before
description: Average annual salary (USD) for the occupational cohort before current AI adoption period

name: average_salary_after
description: Average annual salary (USD) for the occupational cohort after AI adoption effects on compensation

name: salary_growth_rate
description: Percentage change in average salary attributable to AI adoption and productivity gains

name: labor_cost_reduction
description: Fractional reduction in total labor cost achieved through automation and efficiency gains

name: operational_cost_reduction
description: Fractional reduction in total operational costs achieved through AI-driven efficiency improvements

name: productivity_index_before
description: Composite labor productivity index for the cohort before AI adoption (normalized; 1.0 = average)

name: productivity_index_after
description: Composite labor productivity index for the cohort after AI adoption

name: productivity_gain_percent
description: Percentage increase in productivity index attributable to AI adoption

name: customer_satisfaction_score
description: Customer satisfaction rating on a 0–100 scale (e.g., CSAT or NPS-derived composite)

name: revenue_growth_rate
description: Annual revenue growth rate, partially attributable to AI-driven efficiency and innovation

name: profit_margin_change
description: Change in profit margin (percentage points) resulting from AI investment and cost effects

name: innovation_index
description: Composite score (0–1) measuring AI-driven product, process, and business model innovation

name: automation_risk_score
description: Probability (0–1) that the occupational cohort's tasks are susceptible to full automation within the observation horizon

name: occupation_vulnerability_score
description: Adjusted automation risk accounting for reskilling uptake; lower than raw automation_risk_score when reskilling is high

name: employee_resistance_score
description: Aggregate measure of workforce resistance or reluctance toward AI adoption (0 = full acceptance, 1 = full resistance)

name: regulatory_pressure_score
description: Index of regulatory and compliance burden related to AI deployment in the jurisdiction (0–1); higher in advanced economies

name: net_employment_change
description: Net change in jobs: jobs_after_ai minus jobs_before_ai. Positive = net job creation; negative = net displacement

name: workforce_resilience_score
description: Composite index (0–1) measuring the organization's ability to adapt its workforce to AI disruption; combines reskilling, digital maturity, and resistance metrics

name: ai_transformation_success
description: Primary ML target variable. Three-class label based on composite AI transformation outcome: Success, Partial Success, or Failure. Classes are approximately balanced (33% each).
